sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What is the closest star to the Earth that gives us heat and light?
Where are raw materials usually turned into finished goods in large quantities?
Which of these habits is essential for maintaining happy and healthy living?
Which simple machine helps people easily draw a bucket of water from a deep well?
People living in very hot desert areas usually wear clothes made of what material to stay cool?
What is the natural satellite that revolves around the Earth?
Which natural raw material is primarily used by industries to make paper?
How many hours of sleep does a growing child typically need every night for optimal health?
A 'wheel and axle' mechanism is commonly found in which of the following objects?
What kind of houses are traditionally built in areas where it rains heavily to prevent flood water from entering?
Briefly explain the difference between a raw material and a finished product. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A raw material is a natural resource like cotton, while a finished product is the final useful item, like a shirt, made in a factory.

questions.question_text: Why does the moon appear to change its shape every night in our sky? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The moon does not have its own light. It reflects sunlight. We see different shapes depending on how much of the sunlit part faces Earth.

questions.question_text: State two healthy hygiene habits you should strictly follow before eating your meals. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Before eating meals, you should always wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water, and ensure that your food is properly covered and clean.

questions.question_text: Why do people living in different regions of the world eat different types of food? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: People eat different foods because the specific climate and soil in their region determine what crops can easily grow and what animals can survive there.

questions.question_text: How does a lever help us in our daily lives? Give one example. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A lever is a simple machine that makes lifting heavy objects easier by using a resting pivot point. A seesaw in a park is a common example.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are an astronaut traveling to space. Describe what you would see when you look back at the Earth. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: When I look back at the Earth from space, I would see a giant, beautiful blue sphere shining brightly. I would see large blue oceans, white swirling clouds covering different areas, and patches of green and brown land masses scattered across the globe.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are visiting a chocolate factory. Describe the basic steps of how cocoa beans are turned into a chocolate bar. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, the factory workers roast and crush the raw cocoa beans. Then, they melt them into a thick liquid, mix in sugar and milk, and pour the sweet mixture into rectangular moulds. Finally, it cools down and becomes a solid chocolate bar.

questions.question_text: Explain how the lifestyle, clothing, and houses of people living in snowy regions are different from those in hot deserts. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: In snowy regions, people wear thick fur or woollen clothes, build igloos or houses with sloping roofs, and use sledges. In hot deserts, people wear loose cotton clothes to stay cool, build houses with thick walls and flat roofs to keep the heat out, and travel using camels.

questions.question_text: Describe a daily routine that a Class 4 student should follow to maintain a happy, active, and healthy lifestyle. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A Class 4 student should wake up early, brush their teeth, and eat a nutritious breakfast. During the day, they should pay attention in school, drink plenty of water, and spend at least an hour playing outdoor games. Finally, they should read a book and sleep on time.
